title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Earnestly Studying and Implementing the Opinions of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the State Council on Implementing the Rural Revitalization Strategy
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Earnestly Studying and Implementing the Opinions of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council on Implementing the Rural Revitalization Strategy

Fa [2018] No. 52

The Higher People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

Recently, the CPC Central Committee and the State Council issued the Opinions on Implementing the Rural Revitalization Strategy (Zhongfa [2018] No. 1, hereinafter referred to as the "Opinions"). In order to implement the central strategic deployment, give fuller play to the functional role of the people's courts, and provide strong judicial services and guarantees for the implementation of the Rural Revitalization Strategy, notice on relevant issues is hereby given as follows:

1. Fully recognize the great significance of the Rural Revitalization Strategy, actively implement the central spirit, and legally guarantee the implementation of the Rural Revitalization Strategy. Implementing the Rural Revitalization Strategy is a major decision and deployment made by the 19th National Congress of the CPC, a major historical task for securing a decisive victory in building a moderately prosperous society in all respects and building a modern socialist country in all respects, an objective requirement for resolving the contradiction between the people's ever-growing needs for a better life and unbalanced and inadequate development, an inevitable requirement for realizing the "two centenary" goals, and the overall focus of the work concerning agriculture, rural areas, and farmers in the new era. The Opinions provide a top-level design for implementing the Rural Revitalization Strategy, make giving priority to the development of agriculture and rural areas a major principle of modernization, make revitalizing rural areas a major task for realizing the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation, and have very important guiding significance for doing a good job in the work concerning agriculture, rural areas, and farmers in the new era. People's courts at all levels must, from a political and overall perspective, fully recognize the significance of doing a good job in the work of the people's courts to guarantee the implementation of the Rural Revitalization Strategy, deeply understand the central spirit, take Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era as guidance, give full play to their functional role, properly handle various disputes and contradictions in the process of implementing the Rural Revitalization Strategy in accordance with the law, and provide strong judicial services and guarantees for promoting the comprehensive upgrading of agriculture, comprehensive progress of rural areas, and comprehensive development of farmers, and for writing a new chapter in the work concerning agriculture, rural areas, and farmers for the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation.

2. Properly adjudicate various types of cases arising during the implementation of the Rural Revitalization Strategy, and provide a good legal environment for rural revitalization and development. Properly adjudicate cases involving the "separation of three rights" of rural contracted land and homestead land, improve the basic rural management system, and promote the reform of the rural land system; properly adjudicate criminal cases such as those undermining rural social order, disrupting the agricultural market order, endangering the rural investment and financing environment, and hindering the construction of agricultural infrastructure, crack down on and punish criminal acts in accordance with the law, and create a safe and orderly environment for comprehensive rural revitalization; properly adjudicate civil and commercial cases involving the protection of rural property rights, infrastructure construction, basic public services, investment and financing rights and interests, rural scientific and technological innovation, labor and employment protection, etc., protect farmers' rights in accordance with the law, promote rural supply-side structural reform, create a good rural business environment, consolidate the foundation of the elements of rural revitalization, and improve the degree of agricultural modernization; properly adjudicate administrative cases involving the expropriation and requisition of agricultural land, rural planning and construction, and rural economic management, and escort the construction of rural areas under the rule of law.

3. Comprehensively apply adjudication and enforcement measures, enhance the level of institutionalization and legalization of green development in rural areas, and lead rural revitalization with green development. Strengthen the protection of national interests, public interests, collective interests, and the legitimate rights and interests of peasant households in environmental resources in rural areas, concentrate efforts on solving the prominent environmental problems currently faced by rural areas; through criminal, civil, and administrative adjudication means, safeguard the authority of various environmental resources legal systems, and promote the comprehensive establishment of rural ecological protection systems and ecological compensation mechanisms; supervise administrative organs in exercising their powers in accordance with the law, and resolutely punish illegal and criminal acts that destroy agricultural resources, ecological resources, biological resources, etc.; focus on protecting the rights of farmers, peasant households, rural collective economic organizations, and rural cooperative economic organizations that are harmed by illegal acts concerning environmental resources; legally guarantee the development of the rural green ecological economy, firmly establish the concept that lucid waters and lush mountains are invaluable assets, vigorously strengthen the adjudication and enforcement of rural environmental resources cases, and create a new pattern of harmonious coexistence between man and nature.

4. Promote the core socialist values through judicial adjudication, inherit, develop, and enhance outstanding traditional rural culture, and continuously improve the level of rural social civilization. Promote outstanding traditional Chinese culture and family virtues, guide family members to establish codes of conduct, and promote the construction of rural family ethics and family traditions; resolutely eliminate organized crime, crack down severely on rural organized crime forces and clan evil forces, and purify village customs, folk customs, and social customs; promote the virtues of mutual assistance and good neighborliness, and maintain emotional and moral bonds in acquaintance societies; promote the spirit of contract of honesty, trustworthiness, and strict compliance with contracts, and improve the rural business environment; adhere to the substantive resolution of administrative disputes, supervise administrative organs in exercising their powers in accordance with the law in the construction of rural public culture and the transformation of outdated customs and habits, set an example through law enforcement that is civilized, and promote the formation of a new atmosphere of rural civilization. Pay attention to legal education and publicity, promote the rule of law through circuit trials, issuance of typical cases, themed legal publicity, rural legal publicity boards, etc., and lead the trend of respecting and abiding by the law in rural areas.

5. Implement various judicial measures that serve the people, benefit the people, and facilitate the people, and promptly respond to the legitimate rights and interests of the people. Comprehensively apply modern information network technology means such as the Internet, voice telephone systems, mobile phone SMS platforms, and WeChat public accounts, to build a comprehensive convenience service platform covering case filing, adjudication, and enforcement; give full play to the function of the civil summary procedure, improve the mechanism for separating simple and complex cases, and further improve adjudication quality and efficiency; deepen the litigation service mechanism, provide convenience for litigants through circuit trials, community courts, holiday courts, street litigation service stations, etc.; adhere to the principles of "three orientations" and "two conveniences", give full play to the advantage of people's tribunals being close to villages and the people, improve the convenient and efficient judicial service network combining points, lines, and surfaces; take various measures to strengthen the enforcement of cases involving agriculture, ensure that the legitimate rights and interests of farmers are realized in a timely manner; increase judicial assistance efforts, and provide necessary assistance to parties who have genuine financial difficulties.

6. Rely on the new system of rural governance to resolve social conflicts and disputes through multiple channels. For conflicts and disputes arising during the implementation of the Rural Revitalization Strategy, always adhere to the leadership of the Party, follow the principle of "no absence, no overstepping, no misplacement", firmly rely on Party committees and governments at all levels, strengthen communication and cooperation between basic-level people's courts, especially people's tribunals, and other basic-level political power organizations and mass autonomous organizations, give full play to the role of various forces such as rural cadres, judicial assistants, and people's mediators, attach importance to the positive role of village rules and regulations and good customary practices, use the diversified dispute resolution mechanism for social conflicts, rely on the rural governance system combining autonomy, rule of law, and rule of virtue, enhance the overall synergy in promoting the implementation of the Rural Revitalization Strategy, and jointly resolve conflicts and disputes. Pay high attention to and earnestly study and judge the new situations and new problems arising in the adjudication of relevant cases, promptly submit special reports to local Party committees and people's congresses, and propose judicial suggestions to the government and other relevant departments.

February 24, 2018
